channel.title: Turcan Tuna — Publications
channel.description: Research publications and correction notices by Turcan Tuna.

item.title: GrandTour: A legged robotics dataset in the wild for multi-modal perception and state estimation
item.description: Multimodal ANYmal-D field dataset combining the Boxi payload, robot proprioception and surveyed ground truth for perception and state-estimation research.

item.title: TRaIL-Odom: Tightly Coupled Continuous Time Radar-IMU-LiDAR Odometry With Adaptive Doppler Weighting
item.description: Radar–IMU–LiDAR odometry adjusts individual Doppler constraints and overall radar weight according to weakly constrained LiDAR directions. Evaluated on 13 sequences.

item.title: BIEVR-LIO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial Odometry through Bump-Image-Enhanced Voxel Maps
item.description: LiDAR-inertial odometry uses oriented height images inside voxels and map-informed sampling to exploit small geometric variations in difficult scenes.

item.title: Holistic Fusion: Task- and Setup-Agnostic Robot Localization and State Estimation With Factor Graphs
item.description: Factor-graph formulation jointly estimates local/global robot states and evolving reference-frame alignments so heterogeneous sensors can be fused across setups.

item.title: CaRLi-V: Camera–RADAR–LiDAR Point-Wise 3-D Velocity Estimation
item.description: Combines radar radial velocities, optical flow and LiDAR ranges to estimate point-wise three-dimensional velocity using a closed-form fusion step.

item.title: One-Shot Badminton Shuttle Detection for Mobile Robots
item.description: Mobile-viewpoint shuttlecock detection with a 20,510-frame, 11-background dataset, semi-automatic annotation and a fine-tuned YOLOv8 detector.

item.title: Large-Scale Autonomous Gas Monitoring for Volcanic Environments: A Legged Robot on Mount Etna
item.description: ANYmal carries a quadrupole mass spectrometer for volcanic gas monitoring. Three autonomous Etna missions report 93–100% autonomy; a separate teleoperated mission sampled natural fumaroles.

item.title: Informed, Constrained, Aligned: A Field Analysis on Degeneracy-Aware Point Cloud Registration in the Wild
item.description: Analyzes and experimentally compares active/passive degeneracy handling, truncated SVD, inequality constraints and Tikhonov regularization for point-cloud registration.

item.title: Continuous-Time State Estimation Methods in Robotics: A Survey
item.description: Unifies and reviews continuous-time estimation using splines and Gaussian processes, relating formulations, applications and open research problems.

item.title: Boxi: Design Decisions in the Context of Algorithmic Performance for Robotics
item.description: Open sensor-payload design connects synchronization, calibration, hardware layout, power and thermal choices to downstream localization and mapping performance.

item.title: ForestLPR: LiDAR Place Recognition in Forests Attentioning Multiple BEV Density Images
item.description: Uses horizontal slices of LiDAR geometry, bird’s-eye-view density images and attention to recognize revisited places in forests.

item.title: Diffusion Based Robust LiDAR Place Recognition
item.description: Diffusion model trained from synthetic LiDAR views of building meshes produces multiple global-position hypotheses in repetitive construction environments.

item.title: LEVA: A High-Mobility Logistic Vehicle with Legged Suspension
item.description: Logistics robot combines steerable wheels, legged suspension and autonomous box loading for transporting payloads up to 85 kg over uneven terrain.

item.title: X-ICP: Localizability-Aware LiDAR Registration for Robust Localization in Extreme Environments
item.description: Detects localizability along optimization directions and uses that information to constrain ICP updates in geometrically uninformative environments.

item.title: Global Path Planning for Autonomous Vehicles in Orchards and Vineyards
item.description: Global-path-planning research for autonomous operations among structured orchard and vineyard rows.

item.title: Autonomous Forest Inventory with Legged Robots: System Design and Field Deployment
item.description: Integrates state estimation, navigation and tree measurement on a legged robot. A Forest of Dean deployment surveyed 0.96 ha in 20 minutes and identified over 100 trees.

item.title: Scientific exploration of challenging planetary analog environments with a team of legged robots
item.description: A team of legged robots combines locomotion, mapping, target perception and scientific instruments for exploration of difficult planetary-analog terrain.

item.title: Deep learning frameworks to learn prediction and simulation focused control system models
item.description: Studies prediction-focused and simulation-focused deep models for nonlinear system identification, including autoencoder and recurrent-network designs.

item.title: Correction to: Deep learning frameworks to learn prediction and simulation focused control system models
item.description: Adds the funding acknowledgement for TUBITAK project 118E807 to the original deep-learning article.

item.title: Design and development of FOLLY: A self-foldable and self-deployable quadcopter
item.description: Develops the mechanics and design of a quadcopter that folds and deploys its arms automatically, extending the earlier FOLLY conference work.

item.title: FOLLY: A Self Foldable and Self Deployable Autonomous Quadcopter
item.description: Introduces a self-folding, self-deploying quadcopter using a crank-slider mechanism and gearing for compact transport and autonomous deployment.
